selection: C10 2018/2019 failed qualification; 2021 and 2022 selected for near-complete public daily-file availability before inspecting measurements or forecast errors
quality_rule: Both years: every month >=70% complete paired daylight hours and <=10% near-idle bright fraction; source UTC must be present and nonconflicting; preserve rejected sources
model: Same fixed flexible HGB hyperparameters and three training augmentations; no evaluation-based tuning
evaluation: February-December after January calibration warmup and four-hour boundary purge
alignment_sensitivity: Repeat joint_gradual with minute-end alignment including refit
inference: Same equal case/horizon paired calendar-block bootstrap 7/14/28 days; fixed-site new-year extension, no independent climate claim
scope: Prospectively declared internal extension after original-study exposure; not public preregistration
